Cheeseball
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:42am

Ingredients




8 ounces cream cheese
1 individual pkg. Good Seasonings Italian dressing mix
1 cup walnuts, crushed

Preparation

1 Blend cream cheese and dressing; mix thoroughly. Garlic powder and Parmesan cheese may be added according to individual preference. Form the cream cheese mixture into a ball; roll in the crushed walnuts until entire ball is coated. Wrap with plastic wrap; let sit overnight. Serve.
